rule_1.description: Interleave characters from main and vice, starting with main for odd steps.

rule_2.description: Reverse the input, shift characters by step number and concatenate with shifted original.

rule_3.description: Appends a character from the input based on step number modulo logic.

rule_4.description: Add current and previous_main mod 26 for first 5 chars.

rule_1.description: Interweave main and vice; odd experiment steps lead with main, even steps lead with vice.

rule_2.description: Reverse current, shift all letters forward by the experiment step number modulo 26, then concatenate shifted_reverse + shifted_current.

rule_3.description: Let a = step_number mod 10, using 10 when the remainder is 0; append current[a-1] repeated a times when available.

rule_4.description: Use the previous experiment's main sequence: add alphabet indices of the first five current chars and previous_main position-wise modulo 26, then append the unchanged remainder.

rule_5.description: On prime-numbered experiment steps, replace every occurrence of the most frequent current letter with its next alphabet letter; otherwise leave current unchanged.
